    Proposition 8.12: the stem product #

    def:stem-product and prop:intrinsic-stem-product (local-ray-geometry.tex): for rays r : x → y, s : y → z, r * s = r q_y^n s for the least n with r q_y^n s ≠ 0, and 0 if there is none. In ray terms the endpoint subbimodule U_r is the set of rays q^i r q^j, and the product of the sets U_r U_s is U_{r*s} (stem_U). Hence the stem product is associative (stem_assoc), and it is the ray product when the latter is nonzero (stem_of_mul_ne).
